description: Phase 7 — unencrypted PGP secret key ring (Ed25519 primary + ECDH cv25519 subkey). Same key cryptographically as pgp/synthetic/v4-ed25519-pub.asc; this is the secret-key counterpart. Phase 7 derives the public key from each PGPSecretKey, emits the same-shape pURL as the public-key Phase 6 path, plus DerivedFromPrivateKey=true and Envelope=plaintext. (Relocated from edge-cases/pgp/private-key-block.asc; was Phase-6 boundary fixture.)
